title: unified-rollouts: multi-metric canary + shadow A/B autorollback (safety + observability)
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: We need safer, observable rollouts for mixed traffic (canary + A/B + shadow) where multiple signals determine rollback. This PR introduces a multi-metric autorollback engine, extends canary/AB/shadow routing semantics to support composite metric quorums, and adds telemetry + e2e tests. Motivation: past incidents (see SUP-1421) showed single-metric rollbacks either over-reacted to noisy signals or were too slow to stop regressions. The goals are: 1) enable composite metric definitions (error-rate, latency p95, token-regression) with weighting and quorum; 2) support separate thresholds and quorums for shadow vs live canaries and A/B; 3) add stability guards to avoid flapping (cooldown windows, minimum sample sizes); 4) surface rollback decision diagnostics to the Console and alerting; 5) maintain backward compatibility with existing rollout configs. Changes: - rollout engine: added MultiMetricEvaluator and QuorumCoordinator with clear config schema - routing: canary/AB/shadow tagging extended so shadow traffic can use probing windows and separate metric groups - safety guards: min-samples, exponential backoff for re-tries, quarantine stage that isolates suspect variants - observability: added rollback_decision trace events, detailed metrics for component-level signals, and an index in trace logs for audit - e2e + unit tests: added integration tests that run a simulated workload across canary/AB/shadow combinations - migrations: config migration helper included to translate single-metric rules to default composite rules Checklist: - [x] Design doc (ENG-2345) linked - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration / e2e tests added - [x] Console telemetry hooks wired - [x] Docs draft in redwood-docs (follow-up PR) Testing notes: local unit + integration on GH actions; simulated load tests ran in_perf_lab against a staging rollout; addressed flaky e2e test by increasing min-sample threshold. Backwards compatibility: existing single-metric configs are accepted and auto-upgraded to a single-entry composite with identical semantics. Migration: included a small CLI helper: rollouts migrate-config --from-single-metric. Impact: improves rollback precision, reduces false positives, and provides richer debugging data for SREs and platform engineers. See linked Linear tickets for follow-ups (ENG-2401: console UI for decision drilldown).

review_comments: Jordan Lee: Please add stronger observability around the quorum decision path — can we log raw signal aggregates (counts, means) as part of the rollback_decision event?
Asha Patel: Added raw aggregates to rollback_decision trace events and updated metrics to include sample counts.
Priya Kumar: Tests look good; worried about perf impact of evaluating many metrics per request. Have you profiled evaluator hot paths?
Asha Patel: Added microbenchmarks in multi_metric_evaluator_test; evaluator uses cached aggregations and short-circuits when quorum already reached. Measured ~<1% p95 overhead in staging probe runs.
Evan Chen: Flaky e2e on CI (timing) — recommend increasing min-samples and adding deterministic seeding for simulated requests.
Asha Patel: Increased min-samples and seeded harness RNG. Rerun CI, all green.
release_notes: Enhance rollouts with multi-metric autorollback, separate shadow/canary quorum semantics, stability guards, and improved diagnostics. Includes migration helper for existing configs.
